//: Not wired into `vp run typecheck` (this directory isn't a pnpm workspace package — no package.json) and not read by the `deploy-app-subdomain` vitest project either. It exists solely so oxlint's type-aware lint (lint.options.typeCheck in the root vite.config.ts) can resolve `node:fs`/`node:path`/`import.meta.dirname` when it type-checks a file here by explicit path, which is what the `vp staged` pre-commit hook does. Without this, TS2591 ("Cannot find name 'node:fs'") fires on every file in __tests__/ that reads the config files or the workflow from disk. The vitest run remains the actual correctness oracle for this directory — see README.md.
